Calm handling explained at midday
This article covers the basics for guests
Companion Animal Travel Desk routine guidance

Aurelia Skyways asks travelers to contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as companion animal travel is planned. Early contact helps the team review booking details, confirm the handling path, and prepare the proper care notes for the journey. This is the safest way to avoid delays at the airport.

The desk coordinates support from the first reservation check through arrival pickup. Staff review the passenger record, confirm that the animal is eligible for travel, and note any special handling needs. If a crate, carrier, or document is missing, the traveler is told what must be corrected before the trip continues.

Guests should arrive with the animal calm, secure, and ready for inspection. The carrier must stay closed unless staff ask for it to be opened. The traveler should keep leash control when a pet is outside the carrier and follow every direction from the senior coordinator or the handling agent. If the animal appears distressed, the desk will slow the process and adjust the handoff steps where possible.

Documentation must remain available at every stage. The traveler should keep identification, health papers, and any required travel notes close at hand. If the file is incomplete, staff will pause the transfer until the matter is resolved. This protects the animal and helps the airport team complete the record accurately.

At pickup, the companion animal is released only after the traveler is confirmed and the match is verified. Please remain near the assigned area and listen for staff instructions. If someone else is collecting the animal, that person must be approved in advance and be ready to present the proper details. Mariam Dubois and Felix Ramos should expect the same careful review as every other guest.

For the best outcome, keep communication clear, arrive prepared, and follow the desk process without delay. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will assist from booking through release, and further help is available through Aurelia Skyways customer support.
